Authors: Lianghao Luo, Xizhou Bu, Ruyan Liu, Qingqiu Huang, Chufeng Tang, Xiaoshuai Hao, Hongbo Wang, Wei Li

Plan in Sandbox, Navigate in Open Worlds: Learning Physics-Grounded Abstracted Experience for Embodied Navigation VLN

embodied navigation physics-grounded semantic abstraction Reinforcement Learning sim-to-real transfer vision-language models

简要说明：SAGE框架让具身导航智能体在物理基础的语义抽象中学习，提升了规划器辅助的性能并实现了向真实机器人的迁移。

TLDR: The SAGE framework enables embodied navigation agents to learn in physics-grounded semantic abstractions, improving planner-assisted performance and transfer to real robots.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated exceptional general reasoning capabilities. However, their performance in embodied navigation remains hindered by a scarcity of aligned open-world vision and robot control data. Despite simulators providing a cost-effective alternative for data collection, the inherent reliance on photorealistic simulations often limits the transferability of learned policies. To this end, we propose \textit{\textbf{S}andbox-\textbf{A}bstracted \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{E}xperience} (\textbf{\textit{SAGE}}), a framework that enables agents to learn within a physics-grounded semantic abstraction rather than a photorealistic simulation, mimicking the human capacity for mental simulation where plans are rehearsed in simplified physics abstractions before execution. \textit{SAGE} system operates via three synergistic phases: (1) \textit{Genesis}: constructing diverse, physics-constrained semantic environments to bootstrap experience; (2) \textit{Evolution}: distilling experiences through Reinforcement Learning (RL), utilizing a novel asymmetric adaptive clipping mechanism to stabilize updates; (3) \textit{Navigation}: bridging the abstract policy to open-world control. We demonstrate that \textit{SAGE} significantly improves planner-assisted embodied navigation, achieving a 53.21\% LLM-Match Success Rate on A-EQA (+9.7\% over baseline), while showing encouraging transfer to physical indoor robot deployment.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）已展现出卓越的通用推理能力。然而，在具身导航任务中，由于缺乏对齐的开放世界视觉与机器人控制数据，其性能仍受限制。尽管模拟器为数据收集提供了成本效益较高的替代方案，但对逼真视觉模拟的固有依赖常制约所学策略的可迁移性。为此，我们提出一种基于物理约束的语义抽象学习框架——**沙盒抽象化具身经验（SAGE）**。该框架使智能体能在物理语义抽象环境中学习，而非依赖逼真视觉模拟，从而模拟人类在执行前通过简化物理抽象进行心理预演的能力。SAGE 系统通过三个协同阶段运行：（1）**生成**：构建多样化、物理约束的语义环境以启动经验积累；（2）**演化**：通过强化学习（RL）提炼经验，利用新型非对称自适应剪裁机制稳定策略更新；（3）**导航**：将抽象策略与开放世界控制相衔接。实验表明，SAGE 显著提升了规划器辅助的具身导航性能，在 A-EQA 数据集上达到 53.21% 的 LLM 匹配成功率（较基线提升 9.7%），并在室内物理机器人部署中展现出良好的迁移能力。

Authors: Zhixuan Shen, Jiawei Du, Ziyu Guo, Han Luo, Lilan Peng, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Haonan Luo, Tianrui Li

EFGCL: Learning Dynamic Motion through Spotting-Inspired External Force Guided Curriculum Learning Locomotion

reinforcement learning curriculum learning legged robots dynamic motion sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出EFGCL，一种利用外部辅助力引导强化学习的策略，帮助四足机器人高效学习动态全身运动，如后空翻和跳跃，并实现了仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper introduces EFGCL, a guided RL approach that uses external assistive forces to help legged robots efficiently learn dynamic whole-body motions like flips and jumps, enabling successful sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Learning dynamic whole-body motions for legged robots through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to the high risk of failure, which makes efficient exploration difficult and often leads to unstable learning. In this paper, we propose External Force Guided Curriculum Learning (EFGCL), a guided RL approach based on the principle of physical guidance, in which external assistive forces are introduced during training. Inspired by spotting in artistic gymnastics, EFGCL enables agents to physically experience successful motion executions without relying on task-specific reward shaping or reference trajectories. Experiments on a quadrupedal robot performing Jump, Backflip, and Lateral-Flip tasks demonstrate that EFGCL accelerates learning of the Jump task by approximately a factor of two and enables the acquisition of complex whole body motions that conventional RL methods fail to learn. We further show that the learned policies can be deployed on real robot, reproducing motions consistent with those observed in simulation. These results indicate that physically guided exploration, which allows agents to experience success early in training, is an effective and general strategy for improving learning efficiency in dynamic whole-body motion tasks.

摘要（中文）：由于高失败风险，使得探索效率低下且常导致学习过程不稳定，通过强化学习训练四足机器人完成动态全身运动仍具挑战性。本文提出基于物理引导原则的外部力引导课程学习（EFGCL）方法，在训练过程中引入外部辅助力。该方法受艺术体操中保护动作启发，使智能体能通过物理体验成功执行动作，而无需依赖特定任务奖励设计或参考轨迹。在四足机器人完成跳跃、后空翻和侧空翻任务的实验中，EFGCL将跳跃任务的学习速度提升约两倍，并成功习得传统强化学习方法无法掌握的复杂全身运动。研究进一步表明，习得策略可部署于实体机器人，复现与仿真一致的动作。这些结果表明，让智能体在训练早期通过物理引导体验成功的探索策略，是提升动态全身运动任务学习效率的有效通用方法。

Authors: Keita Yoneda, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada

Muninn: Your Trajectory Diffusion Model But Faster RLRobot

trajectory diffusion caching real-time planning denoiser acceleration uncertainty budget

简要说明：Muninn是一种无需训练、基于缓存的加速方法，通过在有界不确定性预算内重用降噪器输出来加速基于扩散的轨迹规划器，实现实时机器人控制，无需重新训练且不牺牲轨迹质量。

TLDR: Muninn is a training-free caching wrapper that accelerates diffusion-based trajectory planners for real-time robot control by reusing cached denoiser outputs within a certified uncertainty budget, without retraining or sacrificing trajectory quality.

Abstract: Diffusion-based trajectory planners can synthesize rich, multimodal robot motions, but their iterative denoising makes online planning and control prohibitively slow. Existing accelerations either modify the sampler or compress the network--sacrificing plan quality or requiring retraining without accounting for downstream control risk. We address the problem of making diffusion-based trajectory planners fast enough for real-time robot use without retraining the model or sacrificing trajectory quality, and in a way that works across diverse state-space diffusion architectures. Our key insight is that diffusion trajectory planners expose two signals we can exploit: a cheap probe of how their internal trajectory representation changes across steps, and analytic coefficients that describe how denoiser errors affect the sampler's state update. By calibrating the first signal against the second on offline runs, we obtain a per-step score that upper-bounds how far the final trajectory can deviate when we reuse a cached denoiser output, and we treat this bound as an uncertainty budget that we can spend over the denoising process. Building on this insight, we present Muninn, a training-free caching wrapper that tracks this uncertainty budget during sampling and, at each diffusion step, chooses between reusing a cached denoiser output when the predicted deviation is small and recomputing the denoiser when it is not. Across standard benchmarks Muninn delivers up to 4.6x wall-clock speedups across several trajectory diffusion models by reducing denoiser evaluations, while preserving task performance and safety metrics. Muninn further certifies that cached rollouts remain within a specified distance of their full-compute counterparts, and we validate these gains in real-time closed-loop navigation and manipulation hardware deployments. Project page: https://github.com/gokulp01/Muninn.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的轨迹规划器能够生成丰富、多模态的机器人运动，但其迭代去噪过程使得在线规划与控制变得极为缓慢。现有加速方法要么修改采样器，要么压缩网络——这会牺牲规划质量，或者要求在不考虑下游控制风险的情况下重新训练模型。我们致力于解决如何使基于扩散的轨迹规划器在无需重新训练模型或降低轨迹质量的前提下，达到足以支持实时机器人应用的速度，且该方法能适用于多种状态空间扩散架构。我们的核心洞见在于，扩散轨迹规划器提供了两种可利用的信号：一是其内部轨迹表示在扩散步骤间变化的廉价探测信号，二是描述去噪器误差如何影响采样器状态更新的解析系数。通过在离线运行中将第一种信号与第二种信号进行校准，我们得到一个每步评分，该评分上限限定了在复用缓存的去噪器输出时最终轨迹可能偏离的最大范围，我们将此界限视为可在整个去噪过程中使用的不确定性预算。基于这一洞见，我们提出了Muninn——一种无需训练的缓存封装器，它在采样过程中跟踪此不确定性预算，并在每个扩散步骤中，根据预测偏差的大小决定是复用缓存的去噪器输出（当偏差较小时），还是重新计算去噪器（当偏差较大时）。在标准基准测试中，Muninn通过减少去噪器评估次数，为多种轨迹扩散模型实现了高达4.6倍的实时加速，同时保持了任务性能与安全指标。Muninn进一步确保缓存的轨迹推演结果与全计算版本的距离始终在指定范围内，我们在实时闭环导航与操作硬件部署中验证了这些优势。项目页面：https://github.com/gokulp01/Muninn。

Authors: Gokul Puthumanaillam, Hao Jiang, Ruben Hernandez, Jose Fuentes, Paulo Padrao, Leonardo Bobadilla, Melkior Ornik

Neural Distance-Guided Path Integral Control for Tractor-Trailer Navigation AutonomousDriving

tractor-trailer navigation neural distance encoder LiDAR perception Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) agricultural environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种神经距离编码器，用于快速准确估计拖拉机-拖车整体与原始激光雷达点云之间的距离，并将其集成到模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器中，以实现杂乱农业环境下的实时安全导航。

TLDR: The paper proposes a neural distance encoder that provides fast and accurate distance estimates between a full tractor-trailer body and raw LiDAR, integrated into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller for safe, real-time navigation in cluttered agricultural environments.

Abstract: Autonomous and safe navigation of tractor-trailer systems requires accurate, real-time collision avoidance and dynamically feasible control, particularly in cluttered and complex agricultural environments. This is challenging due to their articulated, deformable geometries and nonlinear dynamics. Traditional methods oversimplify vehicle geometry or rely on precomputed distance fields that assume a known map, limiting their applicability in dynamic, partially unknown environments. To address these limitations, we propose a geometric neural encoder that provides fast and accurate distance estimates between the full tractor-trailer body and raw LiDAR perception, enabling real-time, map-free geometric reasoning. These learned distances are integrated into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller, allowing the system to incorporate true articulated geometry directly into its cost evaluation and enabling more responsive navigation in challenging agricultural settings. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework generates dynamically feasible and safe trajectories for navigating tractor-trailer systems in cluttered and complex environments.

摘要（中文）：拖拉机挂车系统的自主安全导航需要精确、实时的避障和动态可行的控制策略，在复杂农业环境中尤为关键。该系统面临的挑战在于其铰接式可变形的几何结构以及非线性动力学特性。传统方法要么过度简化车辆几何模型，要么依赖基于已知地图预计算的距离场，这限制了它们在动态且部分未知环境中的适用性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种几何神经编码器，能够快速精确地估算完整拖拉机挂车车身与原始激光雷达感知数据之间的距离，实现实时、无需地图的几何推理。这些学习得到的距离被集成至模型预测路径积分控制器中，使得系统能够将真实铰接几何结构直接纳入成本评估，从而在具有挑战性的农业场景中实现更灵敏的导航。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架能够在杂乱复杂环境中为拖拉机挂车系统生成动态可行且安全的运动轨迹。

Authors: Peng Wei, Chen Peng, Stavros Vougioukas

PhyGround: Benchmarking Physical Reasoning in Generative World Models WorldModel

generative world models physical reasoning video generation benchmark physics-aware evaluation

简要说明：PhyGround 是一个用于评估生成式世界模型中物理推理的基准，包含精心设计的提示、物理定律分类法和一个用于自动化评估的专用视觉语言模型评判器。

TLDR: PhyGround is a benchmark for evaluating physical reasoning in generative world models, with curated prompts, a taxonomy of physical laws, and a specialized VLM judge for automated evaluation.

Abstract: Generative world models are increasingly used for video generation, where learned simulators are expected to capture the physical rules that govern real-world dynamics. However, evaluating whether generated videos actually follow these rules remains challenging. Existing physics-focused video benchmarks have made important progress, but they still face three key challenges, including the coarse evaluation frameworks that hide law-specific failures, response biases and fatigue that undermine the validity of annotation judgments, and automated evaluators that are insufficiently physics-aware or difficult to audit. To address those challenges, we introduce PhyGround, a criteria-grounded benchmark for evaluating physical reasoning in video generation. The benchmark contains 250 curated prompts, each augmented with an expected physical outcome, and a taxonomy of 13 physical laws across solid-body mechanics, fluid dynamics, and optics. Each law is operationalized through observable sub-questions to enable per-law diagnostics. We evaluate eight modern video generation models through a large-scale, quality-controlled human study, grounded on social science lab experiment design. A total of 459 annotators provided 5,796 complete annotations and over 37.4K fine-grained labels; after quality control, the retained annotations exhibited high split-half model-ranking correlations (Spearman's rho > 0.90). To support reproducible automated evaluation, we release PhyJudge-9B, an open physics-specialized VLM judge. PhyJudge-9B achieves substantially lower aggregate relative bias than Gemini-3.1-Pro (3.3% vs. 16.6%). We release prompts, human annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code on the project page https://phyground.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：生成式世界模型在视频生成中的应用日益广泛，人们期望通过学习模拟器来捕捉现实世界动态的物理规律。然而，评估生成的视频是否真正遵循这些规律仍具挑战性。现有的以物理为重点的视频基准测试已取得重要进展，但仍面临三个关键问题：包括掩盖特定规律失效的粗粒度评估框架、损害标注判断有效性的反应偏差与疲劳效应，以及物理感知不足或难以审计的自动化评估器。为解决这些问题，我们提出PhyGround——一个基于准则的基准测试，用于评估视频生成中的物理推理能力。该基准包含250个精选提示词，每个提示均附有预期物理结果，并涵盖固体力学、流体动力学和光学领域的13类物理定律分类体系。每条定律均通过可观测的子问题操作化，以实现逐定律诊断。我们基于社会科学实验室实验设计，通过大规模质量控制的人类研究评估了八个现代视频生成模型。共459名标注者提供了5,796条完整标注及超过3.74万个细粒度标签；经过质量控制后，保留的标注显示出较高的分半模型排序相关性（斯皮尔曼系数ρ>0.90）。为支持可复现的自动化评估，我们发布了PhyJudge-9B——一个开源的物理专用视觉语言模型评估器。PhyJudge-9B的总体相对偏差显著低于Gemini-3.1-Pro（3.3%对16.6%）。我们在项目页面https://phyground.github.io/上公开了提示词集、人工标注数据、模型检查点及评估代码。

Authors: Juyi Lin, Arash Akbari, Yumei He, Lin Zhao, Haichao Zhang, Arman Akbari, Xingchen Xu, Zoe Y. Lu, Enfu Nan, Hokin Deng, Edmund Yeh, Sarah Ostadabbas, Yun Fu, Jennifer Dy, Pu Zhao, Yanzhi Wang

EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents VLN

skill self-evolution embodied agents skill-aware reflection training-free task execution

简要说明：本文提出EmbodiSkill，一种免训练框架，通过技能感知的反思，使具身智能体能够自我进化技能，通过区分错误技能内容和执行失误来提高任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied agents to self-evolve skills through skill-aware reflection, improving task success by differentiating between incorrect skill content and execution lapses.

Abstract: Embodied agents can benefit from skills that guide object search, action execution, and state changes across diverse environments. Since embodied environments vary across layouts, object states, and other execution factors, these skills must self-evolve from trajectories generated during task execution. However, existing skill self-evolution methods are mainly developed in digital environments and often convert trajectories into coarse skill updates. Directly applying this paradigm to embodied settings is problematic, because a failed task execution may reflect not only incorrect skill content, but also an execution lapse in which the agent fails to follow valid guidance. We propose EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied skill self-evolution through skill-aware reflection and targeted revision. EmbodiSkill interprets each trajectory with respect to the current skill, uses skill-changing evidence to update the skill body, and uses execution-lapse evidence to preserve and emphasize valid guidance. Experiments on ALFWorld and EmbodiedBench show that EmbodiSkill consistently improves embodied task success. On ALFWorld, EmbodiSkill enables a frozen Qwen3.5-27B executor to reach 93.28% task success, outperforming GPT-5.2 used as a direct agent without skills by 31.58%. These results show that skill-aware self-evolution helps embodied agents accumulate reusable procedural knowledge from their own trajectories.

摘要（中文）：具身智能体能够从指导物体搜索、动作执行及状态变化的核心技能中获益，这些技能需适应不同环境下的布局、物体状态及其他执行因素的变化。由于具身环境存在多样性，此类技能必须从任务执行过程中产生的轨迹中实现自我进化。然而，现有的技能自我进化方法主要针对数字环境开发，且常将轨迹转化为粗略的技能更新。若直接将此范式应用于具身场景将产生问题，因为任务执行失败可能不仅源于技能内容错误，也可能由智能体未能遵循有效指导的执行失误导致。本文提出EmbodiSkill框架，该免训练框架通过技能感知反思与针对性修正，实现具身技能的自我进化。EmbodiSkill基于当前技能对每条轨迹进行解析：利用技能变更证据更新技能主体，同时通过执行失误证据保留并强化有效指导。在ALFWorld和EmbodiedBench上的实验表明，EmbodiSkill持续提升具身任务成功率。在ALFWorld中，EmbodiSkill使冻结的Qwen3.5-27B执行器达到93.28%的任务成功率，较直接作为无技能智能体使用的GPT-5.2高出31.58%。这些结果表明，技能感知的自我进化能帮助具身智能体从其自身轨迹中积累可复用的过程性知识。

Authors: Ruofei Ju, Xinrui Wang, Xin Ding, Yifan Yang, Hao Wu, Shiqi Jiang, Qianxi Zhang, Hao Wen, Xiangyu Li, Weijun Wang, Kun Li, Yunxin Liu, Haipeng Dai, Wei Wang, Ting Cao

SleepWalk: A Three-Tier Benchmark for Stress-Testing Instruction-Guided Vision-Language Navigation VLN

vision-language navigation grounded spatial reasoning instruction-grounded trajectory prediction 3D environments embodied reasoning

简要说明：提出SleepWalk基准，用于评估在3D环境中的指令接地轨迹预测，以压力测试视觉语言模型的空间推理和行动接地能力。

TLDR: Introduces SleepWalk, a benchmark for evaluating instruction-grounded trajectory prediction in 3D environments to stress-test the spatial reasoning and action-grounding capabilities of vision-language models.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in multimodal perception and language understanding, yet it remains unclear whether they can reliably ground language into spatially coherent, plausibly executable actions in 3D digital environments. We introduce SleepWalk, a benchmark for evaluating instruction-grounded trajectory prediction in single-scene 3D worlds generated from textual scene descriptions and filtered for navigability. Unlike prior navigation benchmarks centered on long-range exploration across rooms, SleepWalk targets localized, interaction-centric embodied reasoning: given rendered visual observations and a natural-language instruction, a model must predict a trajectory that respects scene geometry, avoids collisions, and terminates at an action-compatible location. The benchmark covers diverse indoor and outdoor environments and organizes tasks into three tiers of spatial and temporal difficulty, enabling fine-grained analysis of grounding under increasing compositional complexity. Using a standardized pointwise judge-based evaluation protocol, we evaluate three frontier VLMs on 2,472 curated 3D environments with nine instructions per scene. Results reveal systematic failures in grounded spatial reasoning, especially under occlusion, interaction constraints, and multi-step instructions: performance drops as the difficulty level of the tasks increase. In general, current VLMs can somewhat produce trajectories that are simultaneously spatially coherent, plausibly executable, and aligned with intended actions. By exposing failures in a controlled yet scalable setting, SleepWalk provides a critical benchmark for advancing grounded multimodal reasoning, embodied planning, vision-language navigation, and action-capable agents in 3D environments.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）在跨模态感知与语言理解方面进展迅速，但能否在三维数字环境中将语言可靠地映射为空间连贯且可执行的动作轨迹，目前仍不明确。我们提出了SleepWalk基准，用于评估在单场景三维世界中基于指令的轨迹预测能力——这些场景由文本描述生成并经过可通行性筛选。与以往侧重于跨房间长距离探索的导航基准不同，SleepWalk专注于局部化、以交互为核心的具体推理任务：给定场景渲染的视觉观测与自然语言指令，模型必须预测出符合场景几何结构、避免碰撞且终止于可执行操作位置的轨迹。该基准涵盖多样化的室内外环境，并将任务按时空复杂度划分为三个层级，从而能在逐渐增强的组合复杂度下对语义落地能力进行细粒度分析。通过标准化的逐点评判评估协议，我们在2,472个精心构建的三维场景中（每个场景包含九条指令）评估了三种前沿VLM模型。结果表明，当前模型在具身空间推理方面存在系统性缺陷，尤其在遮挡场景、交互约束和多步骤指令下表现不佳：随着任务难度增加，模型性能显著下降。总体而言，现有VLMs仅能生成部分同时满足空间连贯性、可执行性且符合动作意图的轨迹。SleepWalk通过在受控且可扩展的环境中暴露模型缺陷，为推动三维环境中的具身多模态推理、实体规划、视觉语言导航及可执行动作智能体研究提供了关键基准。

Authors: Niyati Rawal, Sushant Ravva, Shah Alam Abir, Saksham Jain, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Suranjana Trivedy, Amitava Das

Safe Aerial 3D Path Planning for Autonomous UAVs using Magnetic Potential Fields Other

3D path planning magnetic potential fields UAV navigation convolutional autoencoder LiDAR voxel grids

简要说明：利用卷积自编码器处理LiDAR体素网格，将2D磁势场路径规划器扩展至3D，实现无人机在城市场景中的快速安全导航。

TLDR: Extends a 2D magnetic potential field path planner to 3D using a convolutional autoencoder on LiDAR voxel grids, enabling fast and safe 3D UAV navigation in urban environments.

Abstract: Safe autonomous Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires real-time path planning that avoids obstacles. MaxConvNet is a potential-field planner that leverages properties of Maxwell's equations to generate a path to the goal without local minima. We extend the 2D MaxConvNet magnetic field planner to 3D, using a convolutional autoencoder to predict obstacle-aware potential fields from LiDAR-derived 101^3 voxel grids. Evaluation across 100 randomized closed-loop trials in two distinct Cosys-AirSim urban environments, a dense night-time cityscape and a suburban district shows a 100% path planning success rate on both maps without retraining. In offline path planning, 3DMaxConvNet produces path lengths comparable to A* on unseen maps while reducing runtime from 0.155--0.17s to 0.087--0.089s, or about 1.7--1.95 times faster than A*. Against RRT*(3k), 3DMaxConvNet achieves similar path quality while reducing planning runtime from 17.2--17.5s to about 0.09s, which is roughly 193--201 times faster than RRT*(3k).

摘要（中文）：摘要： 城市环境中无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）的安全自主导航需要实时避障路径规划。MaxConvNet是一种基于麦克斯韦方程特性的势场规划器，能够生成无局部最小值的通往目标的路径。本研究将二维MaxConvNet磁场规划器扩展至三维空间，采用卷积自编码器通过激光雷达生成的三维体素网格（101^3）预测具备障碍物感知能力的势场。在Cosys-AirSim两种不同城市环境（密集夜间城市景观与郊区区域）中进行的100次随机闭环测试表明，该规划器在两类地图上均实现100%的路径规划成功率且无需重新训练。在离线路径规划中，三维MaxConvNet在新地图上生成的路径长度与A*算法相当，同时将运行时间从0.155-0.17秒缩短至0.087-0.089秒，速度提升约1.7-1.95倍；相较于RRT*（3k）算法，三维MaxConvNet在获得相近路径质量的前提下，将规划时间从17.2-17.5秒减少至约0.09秒，运行效率提升约193-201倍。

Authors: Haechan Mark Bong, Giovanni Beltrame

VRA: Grounding Discrete-Time Joint Acceleration in Voltage-Constrained Actuation Locomotion

Voltage-Realizable Acceleration joint-level acceleration voltage-constrained actuation execution-level abstraction wheel-legged quadruped

简要说明：本文提出了电压可实现加速度（VRA）接口，用于电驱动关节，确保指令加速度在电压约束下物理可实现，并在轮腿四足机器人等硬件上进行了实验验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes Voltage-Realizable Acceleration (VRA), a joint-level acceleration interface for electric actuators that ensures commanded accelerations are physically achievable given voltage constraints, validated on hardware experiments including a wheel-legged quadruped.

Abstract: Discrete-time joint acceleration constraints are widely used to enforce position and velocity limits. However, under voltage-constrained electric actuators, kinematically admissible accelerations may be physically unrealizable, exposing a missing execution-level abstraction. We propose Voltage-Realizable Acceleration (VRA), a joint-level acceleration interface that grounds kinematic acceleration in voltage-constrained actuator physics by restricting commanded accelerations to voltage-realizable constraints. Hardware experiments on electric actuators and a wheel-legged quadruped show that VRA removes unrealizable accelerations, restores consistent near-constraint execution, and reduces constraint-induced oscillations.

摘要（中文）：离散时间关节加速度约束被广泛用于强制执行位置和速度限制。然而，在电压受限的电动执行器下，运动学上可接受的加速度可能在物理上无法实现，这暴露了执行层抽象缺失的问题。我们提出电压可实现加速度（VRA），这是一种关节级加速度接口，通过将指令加速度限制在电压可实现的约束范围内，将运动学加速度建立在电压受限执行器物理特性的基础上。在电动执行器和轮腿四足机器人上的硬件实验表明，VRA消除了无法实现的加速度，恢复了一致的近约束执行，并减少了约束引起的振荡。

Authors: Lingwei Zhang, Jiaming Wang, Tianlin Zhang, Zhitao Song, Xuanqi Zeng, Weipeng Xia, Zhongyu Li, Yun-hui Liu

Temporal Sampling Frequency Matters: A Capacity-Aware Study of End-to-End Driving Trajectory Prediction AutonomousDriving

temporal sampling frequency end-to-end driving trajectory prediction capacity-aware E2E models

简要说明：该论文表明，端到端驾驶轨迹预测的最佳时间采样频率取决于模型容量，较小模型在较低/中等频率下表现最佳，而较大的VLA模型则从最高频率中受益。

TLDR: This paper shows that optimal temporal sampling frequency for end-to-end driving trajectory prediction depends on model capacity, with smaller models performing best at lower/intermediate frequencies while larger VLA models benefit from highest frequencies.

Abstract: End to end (E2E) autonomous driving trajectory prediction is often trained with camera frames sampled at the highest available temporal frequency, assuming that denser sampling improves performance. We question this assumption by treating temporal sampling frequency as an explicit training set design variable. Starting from high frequency E2E driving datasets, we construct frequency sweep training sets by temporally subsampling camera frames along each trajectory. For each model dataset pair, we train and evaluate the same model under a fixed protocol, so the frequency response reflects how prediction performance changes with sampling frequency. We analyze this response from a capacity aware perspective. Sparse sampling may miss driving relevant cues, while dense sampling may add redundant visual content and off manifold noise. For finite capacity models, this can create a driving irrelevant capacity burden. We evaluate three smaller E2E models and a larger VLA style AutoVLA model on Waymo, nuScenes, and PAVE. Results show model and dataset dependent frequency responses. Smaller E2E models often show non monotonic or near plateau trends and achieve their best 3 second ADE at lower or intermediate frequencies. In contrast, AutoVLA achieves its best 3 second ADE and FDE at the highest evaluated frequency on all three datasets. Iteration matched controls suggest that the advantage of lower or intermediate frequencies for smaller models is not explained only by unequal training update counts. These findings show that temporal sampling frequency should be reported and tuned, rather than fixed to the highest available value.

摘要（中文）：端到端（E2E）自动驾驶轨迹预测通常采用最高可用时间频率采样的相机帧进行训练，人们普遍认为更密集的采样能提升性能。本文通过将时间采样频率作为明确的训练集设计变量，对这一假设提出了质疑。我们从高频E2E驾驶数据集出发，通过沿每条轨迹在时间上对相机帧进行下采样，构建了频率扫描训练集。针对每个模型-数据集组合，我们在固定协议下训练和评估同一模型，使频率响应能反映预测性能随采样频率的变化情况。我们从容量感知的角度分析了这一响应：稀疏采样可能遗漏驾驶相关线索，而密集采样则可能引入冗余视觉内容与流形外的噪声，对于有限容量的模型，这可能造成与驾驶无关的容量负担。我们在Waymo、nuScenes和PAVE数据集上评估了三个小型E2E模型及一个大型VLA风格的AutoVLA模型。结果表明，频率响应特性因模型和数据集而异：较小型的E2E模型常呈现非单调或接近平稳的趋势，并在较低或中等频率处达到最佳3秒平均位移误差（ADE）；而AutoVLA在所有三个数据集上的最高评估频率处取得了最优的3秒ADE与最终位移误差（FDE）。经迭代匹配控制实验验证，较小模型在低中频段的优势不能仅用训练更新次数差异来解释。这些发现表明，时间采样频率应被明确报告并作为可调参数，而非固定为最高可用值。

Authors: Yumao Liu, Tao Liu, Xiangyu Li, Jiaxiang Li, Ke Ma

JODA: Composable Joint Dynamics for Articulated Objects Manipulation

articulated objects joint dynamics differentiable simulation vision-language model dynamics field

简要说明：JODA提出了一个从多模态输入生成可解释、可组合的关节动力学模型的框架，用于铰接物体，实现真实模拟和基于梯度的优化。

TLDR: JODA introduces a framework for generating interpretable, composable joint dynamics models for articulated objects from multimodal inputs, enabling realistic simulation and gradient-based refinement.

Abstract: Articulated objects used in simulation and embodied AI are typically specified by geometry and kinematic structure, but lack the fine-grained dynamical effects that govern realistic mechanical behavior, such as frictional holding, detents, soft closing, and snap latching. Existing approaches either ignore the detailed structure of dynamics entirely, or use simple models with limited expressiveness. We introduce JODA, a framework for generating joint-level dynamics as a structured three-channel field over the joint degree of freedom, capturing conservative forces, dry friction, and damping. Instantiated using shape-constrained piecewise cubic interpolation (PCHIP), this formulation defines a compact and expressive function space that is both interpretable and compatible with differentiable simulation. Building on this representation, we develop methods for inferring and refining joint dynamics from multimodal inputs. Given visual observations and joint context, a vision-language model proposes structured dynamical primitives, which are composed into a unified dynamics field. The resulting representation supports both direct manipulation and gradient-based refinement. We demonstrate that JODA enables plausible and controllable modeling of diverse joint behaviors, providing a unified interface for inference, editing, and optimization. Code and example assets with their generated profiles will be released upon publication.

摘要（中文）：仿真和具身人工智能中使用的铰接对象通常由几何和运动学结构定义，但缺乏控制真实机械行为的细粒度动力学效应，如摩擦保持、定位制动、软性闭合和卡扣锁止。现有方法要么完全忽略动力学的详细结构，要么采用表达能力有限的简单模型。 我们提出JODA框架，该框架通过关节自由度上的结构化三通道场生成关节级动力学，涵盖保守力、干摩擦和阻尼。通过形状约束的分段三次插值法实例化，这种表述定义了一个紧凑且富有表现力的函数空间，既具备可解释性，又与可微分仿真兼容。基于此表征，我们开发了从多模态输入中推断和优化关节动力学的方法。在给定视觉观察和关节上下文的情况下，视觉语言模型可生成结构化动力学基元，进而组合成统一的动力学场。所得表征同时支持直接操控和基于梯度的优化。我们证明JODA能够对多样化关节行为进行合理且可控的建模，为推断、编辑和优化提供统一接口。代码及生成配置文件的示例资源将于发表时同步公开。

Authors: Tianhong Gao, Cheng Yu, Yinghao Xu, Mengyu Chu

How Mobile World Model Guides GUI Agents? WorldModel

mobile world model GUI agents renderable code multimodal supervision action entropy

简要说明：该论文为移动GUI代理训练多模态世界模型，评估其保真度和鲁棒性，并展示了生成轨迹可提升代理训练，而基于文本的反馈有助于分布外执行。

TLDR: The paper trains multimodal world models for mobile GUI agents, evaluates their fidelity and robustness, and shows how generated rollouts can improve agent training while text-based feedback aids OOD execution.

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models have enabled mobile GUI agents to perceive visual interfaces and execute user instructions, but reliable prediction of action consequences remains critical for long-horizon and high-risk interactions. Existing mobile world models provide either text-based or image-based future states, yet it remains unclear which representation is useful, whether generated rollouts can replace real environments, and how test-time guidance helps agents of different strengths. To answer the above questions, we filter and annotate mobile world-model data, then train world models across four modalities: delta text, full text, diffusion-based images, and renderable code. These models achieve SoTA performance on both MobileWorldBench and Code2WorldBench. Furthermore, by evaluating their downstream utility on AITZ, AndroidControl, and AndroidWorld, we obtain three findings. First, renderable code reconstruction achieves high in-distribution fidelity and provides effective multimodal supervision for data construction, while text-based feedback is more robust for online out-of-distribution (OOD) execution. Second, world-model-generated trajectories can provide transferable interaction experience in the training process and improve agents' end-to-end task performance, although these data do not preserve the original distribution. Last, for overconfident mobile agents with low action entropy, posterior self-reflection provides limited gains, suggesting that world models are more effective as prior perception or training supervision than as universal post-hoc verifiers.

摘要（中文）：近期视觉语言模型的进步使得移动图形用户界面智能体能够感知视觉界面并执行用户指令，但可靠预测行动后果对于长周期和高风险交互仍然至关重要。现有移动世界模型提供基于文本或基于图像的未来状态，然而何种表示形式更为有效、生成推演能否替代真实环境、以及测试时指导如何帮助不同能力的智能体，这些问题尚未明确。为解答上述疑问，我们筛选并标注了移动世界模型数据，随后训练了四种模态的世界模型：增量文本、完整文本、基于扩散的图像以及可渲染代码。这些模型在MobileWorldBench和Code2WorldBench上均实现了最先进的性能。此外，通过在AITZ、AndroidControl和AndroidWorld三个下游任务评估其效用，我们获得了三项发现：第一，可渲染代码重建在分布内数据上实现高保真度，并为数据构建提供有效的多模态监督，而基于文本的反馈对于在线分布外执行更具鲁棒性；第二，世界模型生成的轨迹可在训练过程中提供可迁移的交互经验，提升智能体端到端任务性能，尽管这些数据未保留原始分布；第三，对于行动熵较低且过度自信的移动智能体，后验自我反思提供的增益有限，这表明世界模型作为先验感知或训练监督手段比作为通用后验验证器更为有效。

Authors: Weikai Xu, Kun Huang, Yunren Feng, Jiaxing Li, Yuhan Chen, Yuxuan Liu, Zhizheng Jiang, Heng Qu, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Xiaolin Hu, Bo An

DRIVE-C: A Controlled Corruption Dataset for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

autonomous driving robustness benchmarking camera degradation perception reliability sensor health monitoring

简要说明：DRIVE-C 是一个用于评估自动驾驶视觉感知鲁棒性的受控损坏数据集，提供基于真实驾驶视频的物理启发性合成退化，并包含元数据和健康指标注释。

TLDR: DRIVE-C is a controlled corruption dataset for evaluating visual perception robustness in autonomous driving, providing physics-inspired synthetic degradations of real-world driving videos with metadata and health annotations.

Abstract: DRIVE-C is a controlled corruption dataset designed to evaluate visual perception robustness in autonomous driving systems. It is built from real-world forward-facing driving videos collected across daytime, nighttime, urban, rural, freeway, and parking environments. Clean clips are anonymized via localized face and license plate blurring, then transformed with physics-inspired synthetic degradations. The dataset contains 10 clean clips and 600 corrupted clips spanning 12 camera degradation types across five severity levels, with per-clip metadata and Global Sensor Health Index (GSHI) annotations. DRIVE-C supports robustness benchmarking, degradation-aware modeling, uncertainty estimation, out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, and sensor health monitoring for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). By providing pixel-aligned clean and degraded video clips with fully reproducible corruption parameters, DRIVE-C offers a structured testbed for studying perception reliability under controlled camera degradation.

摘要（中文）：DRIVE-C是一个用于评估自动驾驶系统视觉感知鲁棒性的受控损坏数据集。该数据集基于真实世界的前向驾驶视频构建，涵盖白天、夜间、城市、乡村、高速公路及停车场等多种环境。原始视频片段通过局部人脸和车牌模糊处理实现匿名化，并基于物理原理添加合成退化效果。该数据集包含10段原始视频和600段损坏视频，涵盖12种相机退化类型及五种严重程度等级，每条视频均附带元数据及全球传感器健康指数（GSHI）标注。DRIVE-C可支持高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的鲁棒性基准测试、退化感知建模、不确定性估计、分布外（OOD）检测及传感器健康监测。通过提供像素级对齐的原始视频与退化视频，并配备完全可复现的损坏参数，DRIVE-C为研究受控相机退化条件下的感知可靠性提供了结构化测试平台。

Authors: Shiva Aher

Learning Point Cloud Geometry as a Statistical Manifold: Theory and Practice Perception3D

point cloud geometry statistical manifold self-supervised learning robotic perception Gaussian distributions

简要说明：本文提出POLI，一种自监督深度神经估计器，将点云局部几何建模为高斯分布的统计流形，提升了机器人感知任务（如定位和物体姿态估计）的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes POLI, a self-supervised deep neural estimator that models point cloud local geometry as a statistical manifold of Gaussian distributions, improving performance for robotic perception tasks like localization and object pose estimation.

Abstract: Point clouds are a fundamental representation for robotic perception tasks such as localization, mapping, and object pose estimation. However, LiDAR-acquired point clouds are inherently sparse and non-uniform, providing incomplete observations of the underlying scene geometry. This makes reliable geometric reasoning challenging and degrades downstream perception performance. Existing approaches attempt to compensate for these limitations by estimating local geometry, but often rely on hand-crafted statistics or end-to-end supervised learning, which can suffer from limited scalability or require large amounts of accurately labeled data. To address these challenges, we explicitly model point cloud geometry under a principled mathematical formulation. We represent local geometry as a statistical manifold induced by a family of Gaussian distributions, where each point is associated with a Gaussian capturing its local geometric structure. Based on this formulation, we introduce Point-to-Ellipsoid (POLI), a deep neural estimator that predicts per-point Gaussian geometry. POLI learns a mapping from point cloud observations to their underlying geometry in a self-supervised manner, removing the need for labeled data while preserving strong geometric inductive biases. The resulting representation integrates seamlessly into existing robotic perception pipelines without architectural modifications. Extensive experiments show that POLI enables accurate and robust geometry estimation and consistently improves performance across diverse robotic perception tasks.

摘要（中文）：点云是机器人感知任务（如定位、建图与物体位姿估计）的基础表示形式。然而，激光雷达获取的点云本质上具有稀疏性与非均匀性，对场景底层几何结构仅提供不完整的观测。这使得可靠的几何推理变得困难，并降低了后续感知任务的性能。现有方法试图通过估计局部几何特征来弥补这些局限，但通常依赖于人工设计的统计量或端到端监督学习，这类方法可能存在可扩展性有限或需要大量精确标注数据的问题。为解决这些挑战，我们基于严格的数学框架对点云几何结构进行显式建模。我们将局部几何表示为高斯分布族诱导的统计流形，其中每个点与一个刻画其局部几何结构的高斯分布相关联。基于此框架，我们提出点对椭球估计器——一种预测逐点高斯几何的深度神经估计器。该模型以自监督方式学习从点云观测到底层几何的映射，无需标注数据的同时保留了强几何归纳偏置。所得表征能够无缝集成到现有机器人感知流程中，无需修改系统架构。大量实验表明，该模型能够实现精准鲁棒的几何估计，并在多种机器人感知任务中持续提升性能表现。

Authors: Jinwoo Lee, Jiwoo Kim, Woojae Shin, Giseop Kim, Hyondong Oh

PaMoSplat: Part-Aware Motion-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction Perception3D

Gaussian splatting dynamic scene reconstruction optical flow part-aware 4D scene editing

简要说明：提出了PaMoSplat，一种利用部件感知和运动先验的动态高斯泼溅框架，通过多视图分割和光流引导实现高质量动态场景重建与4D编辑。

TLDR: A dynamic Gaussian splatting framework that uses part-aware 3D segmentation and motion priors from optical flow to achieve high-fidelity dynamic scene reconstruction and 4D editing.

Abstract: Dynamic scene reconstruction represents a fundamental yet demanding challenge in computer vision and robotics. While recent progress in 3DGS-based methods has advanced dynamic scene modeling, obtaining high-fidelity rendering and accurate tracking in scenarios with substantial, intricate motions remains significantly challenging. To address these challenges, we propose PaMoSplat, a novel dynamic Gaussian splatting framework incorporating part awareness and motion priors. Our approach is grounded in two key observations: 1) Parts serve as primitives for scene deformation, and 2) Motion cues from optical flow can effectively guide part motion. Specifically, PaMoSplat initializes by lifting multi-view segmentation masks into 3D space via graph clustering, establishing coherent Gaussian parts. For subsequent timestamps, we leverage a differential evolutionary algorithm to estimate the rigid motion of these parts using multi-view optical flow cues, providing a robust warm-start for further optimization. Additionally, PaMoSplat introduces an adaptive iteration count mechanism, internal learnable rigidity, and flow-supervised rendering loss to accelerate and optimize the training process. Comprehensive evaluations across diverse scenes, including real-world environments, demonstrate that PaMoSplat delivers superior rendering quality, improved tracking precision, and faster convergence compared to existing methods. Furthermore, it enables multiple part-level downstream applications, such as 4D scene editing.

摘要（中文）：动态场景重建是计算机视觉与机器人领域一个基础且极具挑战性的课题。尽管基于3DGS的方法在动态场景建模方面取得了最新进展，但在运动剧烈且复杂的场景中实现高保真度渲染与精确跟踪仍然面临巨大挑战。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种结合部件感知与运动先验的新型动态高斯泼溅框架——PaMoSplat。该方法的提出基于两个关键观察：1）部件可作为场景形变的基本单元；2）来自光流的运动信息能有效指导部件运动。具体而言，PaMoSplat首先通过图聚类将多视角分割掩码提升至三维空间，建立连贯的高斯部件；对于后续时间戳，则利用差分进化算法结合多视角光流信息估计这些部件的刚性运动，为后续优化提供稳健的初始化。此外，PaMoSplat引入了自适应迭代计数机制、内部可学习刚性约束和光流监督的渲染损失函数，以加速并优化训练过程。在涵盖真实场景的多样化数据集上的综合评估表明，与现有方法相比，PaMoSplat在渲染质量、跟踪精度和收敛速度方面均表现更优，同时支持4D场景编辑等部件级下游应用。

Authors: Yinan Deng, Jianyu Dou, Jiahui Wang, Jingyu Zhao, Yi Yang, Yufeng Yue

Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents Other

continual learning online adaptation self-improving agents embodied agents long-horizon decision-making

简要说明：本文提出Continual Harness方法，这是一种无需重置的在线自适应框架，使具身智能体能够在单一运行中通过迭代优化自身提示、子智能体、技能和记忆来实现自我改进，并在玩《精灵宝可梦》这一长视野、部分可观察的任务中进行了演示。

TLDR: The paper introduces Continual Harness, a reset-free online adaptation method for embodied agents that self-improves by iteratively refining its own prompts, sub-agents, skills, and memory within a single run, demonstrated on the long-horizon, partially observable task of playing Pokemon.

Abstract: Coding harnesses such as Claude Code and OpenHands wrap foundation models with tools, memory, and planning, but no equivalent exists for embodied agents' long-horizon partial-observability decision-making. We first report our Gemini Plays Pokemon (GPP) experiments. With iterative human-in-the-loop harness refinement, GPP became the first AI system to complete Pokemon Blue, Yellow Legacy on hard mode, and Crystal without a lost battle. In the hardest stages, the agent itself began iterating on its strategy through long-context memory, surfacing emergent self-improvement signals alongside human-in-the-loop refinement. Continual Harness removes the human fully from this loop: a reset-free self-improving harness for embodied agents that formalizes and automates what we observed. Starting from only a minimal environment interface, the agent alternates between acting and refining its own prompt, sub-agents, skills, and memory, drawing on any past trajectory data. Prompt-optimization methods require episode resets; Continual Harness adapts online within a single run. On Pokemon Red and Emerald across frontier models, Continual Harness starting from scratch substantially reduces button-press cost relative to the minimalist baseline and recovers a majority of the gap to a hand-engineered expert harness, with capability-dependent gains, despite starting from the same raw interface with no curated knowledge, no hand-crafted tools, and no domain scaffolding. We then close the loop with the model itself: an online process-reward co-learning loop, in which an open-source agent's rollouts through the refining harness are relabeled by a frontier teacher and used to update the model, drives sustained in-game milestone progress on Pokemon Red without resetting the environment between training iterations.

摘要（中文）：诸如Claude Code和OpenHands等编程框架通过工具、记忆与规划功能增强基础模型，但在具身智能体的长时程部分可观测决策领域尚无对等方案。我们首先报告Gemini Plays Pokemon（GPP）实验成果。通过迭代式人机协同框架优化，GPP成为首个在无败绩条件下通关《精灵宝可梦：蓝》《精灵宝可梦：黄（怀旧版）》困难模式及《精灵宝可梦：水晶》的人工智能系统。在最高难度阶段，智能体开始通过长时程记忆迭代策略，在人机协同优化的同时涌现出自我改进信号。持续演化框架则完全移除了人类干预环节：这一为具身智能体设计的无重置自改进框架将我们的观察结果形式化与自动化。从最简环境接口出发，智能体利用历史轨迹数据，在行动与自我优化（提示词、子智能体、技能及记忆模块）之间交替演进。传统提示优化方法需重置任务周期；而持续演化框架可在单次运行中实现在线适应。在多个前沿模型上对《精灵宝可梦：红》和《绿宝石》的测试表明，从零开始的持续演化框架相比极简基线显著降低了按键操作成本，并填补了手工设计专家框架的大部分性能差距，其增益程度与模型能力相关——尽管初始状态仅包含原始交互接口，未注入人工知识、定制工具或领域脚手架。最后我们实现了模型的闭环优化：通过在线过程-奖励协同学习循环，将开源智能体在优化框架中产生的交互轨迹由前沿教师模型重新标注，并用于更新模型参数，从而在《精灵宝可梦：红》的训练迭代间无需重置环境的情况下，持续推动游戏里程碑进程。

Authors: Seth Karten, Joel Zhang, Tersoo Upaa, Ruirong Feng, Wenzhe Li, Chengshuai Shi, Chi Jin, Kiran Vodrahalli

Do multimodal models imagine electric sheep? WorldModel

multimodal models mental imagery visual world model action sequences spatial reasoning

简要说明：该论文表明，多模态模型在训练用于解决空间谜题的动作序列时，会形成隐式心理意象（不完美的世界模型），并且整合这些视觉标记可以提高推理性能。

TLDR: This paper shows that multimodal models develop implicit mental imagery (imperfect world models) when trained for action sequences on spatial puzzles, and that integrating these visual tokens improves reasoning performance.

Abstract: Yes. We find that large multimodal models develop mental imagery when solving spatial puzzles, and they do imagine sheep when solving sheep puzzles. We fine-tune a Qwen3.5 VLM to solve twelve diverse visual reasoning tasks -- including tangram, jigsaw, sokoban, 3D mental rotation, and rush hour -- that require understanding geometry, spatial relationships, and the consequences of actions. By supervising the model to predict the open-loop sequence of actions to solve a puzzle from an initial state, we show that the model's activations after each action encode meaningful visual information about the intermediate state. This finding suggests that an imperfect visual world model begins to form as a byproduct of learning to select correct actions, in the absence of any explicit visual supervision. Building on this observation, we propose two ways to sharpen and use the mental images formed by the model. We find that integrating as few as sixteen visual tokens per step into the chain of thought improves the average solve rate from 83% to 89%, with particularly strong gains on reasoning-heavy tasks such as jigsaw and 3D mental rotation.

摘要（中文）：是的。我们发现，大型多模态模型在解决空间谜题时会产生心理意象，它们确实会在解决绵羊谜题时想象绵羊。我们通过微调Qwen3.5视觉语言模型，使其能够解决十二种不同的视觉推理任务——包括七巧板、拼图、推箱子、三维心理旋转和智慧拼图——这些任务要求理解几何形状、空间关系以及行动后果。通过监督模型从初始状态预测解决谜题的开环动作序列，我们发现模型在每步动作后的激活状态编码了关于中间状态的有意义的视觉信息。这一发现表明，在学习选择正确动作的过程中，即使没有任何明确的视觉监督，一个不完美的视觉世界模型也会开始形成。基于这一观察，我们提出了两种方法来优化并利用模型形成的心理图像。研究发现，在思维链中每步仅融入十六个视觉标记，即可将平均解决率从83%提升至89%，在需要强推理能力的任务（如拼图和三维心理旋转）上提升尤为显著。
